item.content:encoded:
Glock 47 Gen 5 MOS in good used condition. Low round count, no major blemishes on slide finish. Comes with Forward Controls Design MOS plate for Trijicon RMR Type 2 RM06. Will also throw in a Forward Controls plate for Aimpoint Acro. Other than optic plate and Ameriglo all black iron sights, gun is stock.

Asking $1300 OBO with the RMR or $900 OBO without. Will come with 2 10 round magazines.

Prefer PPT done in Southbay area of LA/Torrance (Crosshairs) but may be willing to meet depending on location.

Send me any questions you might have.

I will take this listing down when the firearm has sold.

item.title: Orange County - GLOCK 19 Gen3 LNIB, Smith &amp; Wesson M&amp;P 2.0
item.description:
Up for sale is:
Like new in Box (LNIB)- GLOCK 19, Gen-3, with night sights. I am the original owner of this and it has less than 500 rounds...
item.content:encoded:
Up for sale is:

Like new in Box (LNIB)- GLOCK 19, Gen-3, with night sights. I am the original owner of this and it has less than 500 rounds through it. It is all original condition with the serial number on the frame, slide, and barrel to show all original and not a franken Glock. I have the original box and all paperwork including the lock for it, I can provide the two factory mags for it as long as you provide the 10-round mag blocks or I can supply 2 Magpul 10-round mags that are obviously not Glock factory. This has been in my safe for sometime and deserves to be shot. I am asking $600, buyer to pay the transfer DROS, and I will meet at an FFL in Orange County hopefully near Irvine/Lake Forest area.
IMG_4794.jpgIMG_4796.jpgIMG_4797.jpg
Secondly I have a SMITH & WESSON M&P 2.0 (4.25") with night sights in very good condition (S&W model sku 11518), I have more like 1500-2000 rounds through it and it runs flawless I am the original owner, I am only selling because I have a newer version with optic on it. I have the original factory box, extra back straps for size of your choice. This is the off-roster version with no manual safety and capable of firing with no mag inserted (no mag disconnect). No mags with this one but I will buy and provide a 10-round mag if we make a deal. I am asking $700 ( also have a plain black safariland right hand ALS/SLS holster for this I can throw in if interested (holster for the pistol with a TLR-1 HL).

IMG_4801.jpgIMG_4799.jpg

No trades just looking for a local cash deal, unable to send, so in person local Orange County transfers only.
